title: Mission:Important
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Contact

Quest Description: Talk to the Townston Lieutenant about an important mission

Quest Reward: 1250 Gold

Return to: Townston Lieutenant

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Mission:Collect 'Em All

Last Build Updated: 155

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go talk to the Townston Lieutenant in Townston about the Townston Commander's Very Important Mission.

Offer:

Come here, Dungeon Runner. I need you to do something that is of the utmost importance. I would ask another Dungeon Runner to do it, but you have proven yourself more than capable to handle this.

Now, it is too sensitive to talk about it here, so go and talk to the Townston Lieutenant. Tell him I sent you about that thing I need taken care of. This is life or death, Dungeon Runner. I am depending on you.

Turn-in:

Oh, hey. What do you want? The Commander sent you, did he? That thing he needs taken care of? Oooooooh, that thing. Hehehe, I am going to enjoy this.

Client level range: 10–20
